Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: HEALTH
Topic 2.4: Toileting PRACTICES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Toileting PRACTICES. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.
